C_a_molar_ratio_sums._not_a_tautology: Each column is four numerals transcribed independently from the panel; nothing in our pipeline derives one of them from the others.

C_b_factorial._which_were_dropped: NOT IDENTIFIED ANYWHERE IN THE PAPER. The 11 failures are shown only as a change in the Fig 2c pie, so the 109 surviving members cannot be enumerated, let alone addressed.

C_c_fig3h_sign_by_colour._method: Colour identity, not a bar-top detector. Enriched bars are drawn teal and depleted bars grey, so the SIGN is carried by hue and survives a 709 px raster. Separation is categorical: every negative bar has EXACTLY 0 teal pixels and every positive bar has <=44 grey pixels against 260-572 teal.
C_c_fig3h_sign_by_colour._NOT_MEASURED: The MAGNITUDE of the negative bars. Our grey mask over-captures below the baseline (all four returned an identical 93 px extent, which the drawing contradicts), so negative heights are reported as None rather than as a number we do not trust. The sign is unaffected: it comes from hue, not extent.

C_d_fig3h_rank._precision: A RANK, not a value. 44 px vs the next 40 px is a 4 px margin on a 709 px-wide figure; it orders A-11 first but we do not convert any of these to enrichment units and no emitted number depends on them.
